name: Link Card
description: Paste a link, get a branded social card - title, description, site chip and a thumbnail, at Open Graph, square or summary size.

inputs.label: Link
inputs.help: The page this card points at. Only the site is printed, without the protocol, so a long address stays out of the artwork.

inputs.label: Title
inputs.default: Quiet interfaces do more with less
inputs.help: The page title. Nothing here fetches the page, so type it in.

inputs.label: Description
inputs.default: A field note on restraint - fewer controls, clearer defaults, and what happens when a product stops shouting.
inputs.help: The line under the title. Two lines is the most that reads well at thumbnail size.

inputs.label: Site name
inputs.help: Printed in the chip beside the address. Its first letter is the monogram on the chip.

inputs.label: Thumbnail
inputs.help: Drop in a picture, or paste a Lolly URL Capture link for a live screenshot of the page. Leave it empty and the card prints a monogram panel.

inputs.label: Zoom & Position
inputs.help: Zoom scales the thumbnail up; X / Y pan it within its panel (like object-position). Drag a label or type a value.

inputs.label: Size
inputs.help: Where the card is going. Picking one sets the export size, so the file comes out at the size the platform wants.

inputs.label: Accent
inputs.help: The chip, the rule under the title, and the monogram panel that stands in for a missing thumbnail.

values.heading: Field notes, collected
values.body: Six months of small decisions, written down while they were still fresh enough to argue about.

values.heading: Release 4.2 is out
values.body: Faster exports, a calmer sidebar, and print sizes that are finally true to the millimetre.
